connection_condition: rows of posts carrying PostTypeId = 1 share the Id space of all posts and form a strict subset of it
description: A question is a kind of post; every question attribute is drawn from the post attribute set, and the question value domain is a strict subset of the post value domain.

connection_condition: rows of posts carrying PostTypeId = 2 share the Id space of all posts and form a strict subset of it
description: An answer is a kind of post; it is distinguished from other posts by the PostTypeId discriminator rather than by a separate table.

connection_condition: each answer post carries ParentId equal to the Id of the question it responds to
description: A question thread is composed of the answer posts attached to it through ParentId; an answer has no meaning detached from its parent question.
A post carries comments as dependent parts; a comment row is meaningless without the post it annotates.
The editing history of a post is composed of its revision events; the initial-body event count approximates the post count, confirming each post owns its own history.
Voting actions are recorded against posts, linking quality signals to content, but a vote is an independent engagement event rather than a component part of the post.

connection_condition: counting answer posts whose ParentId equals a question reproduces that question's stored AnswerCount
description: Answer count is derived by counting the answer posts attached to a question; the stored value is a faithful denormalisation of that count.

connection_condition: the question's AcceptedAnswerId resolves to an answer post whose ParentId is that same question
description: The accepted answer is selected from among the answers of a question, so acceptance is derived from the answer set rather than being an independent entity.

connection_condition: a subset of badges.Name values shares its value domain with tags.TagName
description: Tag-award badges reuse the tag vocabulary, so a badge name and a tag name can denote the same subject even though they live in different tables.
Badges are awarded to users, connecting recognition events to accounts; the link is recorded on the badge row.
A user authors posts; authorship is recorded on the post row and is the main path from accounts to content.

connection_condition: questions carry tag names embedded as delimited text in posts.Tags; the connection to the tags table is by name, not by a key
description: Questions are labelled with tags, but the association is textual rather than relational, so it must be resolved by parsing the delimited tag string and matching tag names.

connection_condition: postLinks.PostId and postLinks.RelatedPostId both reference posts.Id
description: A declared link connects two posts, expressing that one post is related to another in a way classified by the link type.
